paper.title: Agentic Harness Engineering: Observability-Driven Automatic Evolution of Coding-Agent Harnesses
paper.central_claim: AHE 通过组件/经验/决策三类可观测性（文件级可回滚组件、分层轨迹证据库、自声明预测的变更清单）闭环自动演化编码智能体 harness，十次迭代把 Terminal-Bench 2 从 69.7% 提到 77.0%，且冻结 harness 可迁移到 SWE-bench-verified 与其他基底，表明编码的是通用工程经验。

evidence.quote: Yet harness engineering remains a manual craft, because automating it faces a heterogeneous action space across editable components, voluminous trajectories that bury actionable signal, and edits whose effect is hard to attribute.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者 gap：异质动作空间、轨迹过长淹没信号、编辑效果难归因。

evidence.quote: However, few existing approaches jointly evolve the full set of editable components
evidence.support_explanation: 近邻 gap：多数方法只演化单一组件（提示/技能/playbook）。

evidence.quote: Empirically, ten AHE iterations lift pass@1 on Terminal-Bench 2 from 69.7% to 77.0%, surpassing the human-designed harness Codex (71.9%) and the self-evolving baselines ACE and Training-Free GRPO.
indicating the evolved components encode general engineering experience rather than benchmark-specific tuning.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者泛化主张。

evidence.quote: We drive evolution on the full 89 tasks of Terminal-Bench 2
evidence.support_explanation: 演化使用全部 89 个 TB2 任务；主表在同一 89 任务上报告。

evidence.quote: We run a single AHE campaign of ten iterations from the bash-only
evidence.support_explanation: 仅一次演化运行（十次迭代）。

evidence.quote: finishing in roughly 32 hours; the best resulting configuration is reported as
evidence.support_explanation: 报告的是十次迭代中“最佳”配置（在同一任务集上择优）；演化耗时约 32 小时。

evidence.quote: the Evolve Agent writes only inside the harness workspace, while the runs directory, tracer, verifier, and LLM configuration are read-only
evidence.support_explanation: 可控性约束：只能写工作区，验证器/追踪器/LLM 配置只读。

evidence.quote: Each edit attaches a manifest entry that names the failure evidence, the inferred root cause, the targeted fix, and a predicted impact comprising both expected fixes and at-risk regressions
evidence.support_explanation: 变更清单：证据、根因、修复、预测的修复与风险回归任务。

evidence.quote: In the next round, the loop intersects the predicted-fix and predicted-regression sets with the observed task-level deltas to produce a per-edit verdict.
evidence.support_explanation: 下一轮按任务级差异给出逐编辑裁决。

evidence.quote: distillation, so its verdict lands inside the evidence corpus and binds each prior manifest entry as a contract rather than a rationale.
evidence.support_explanation: 归因在蒸馏前进行，裁决进入证据库。

evidence.quote: to seed a small number of reusable skills from the NexAU source and public coding-agent references.
evidence.support_explanation: 一次性 explore 智能体从框架源码和公开编码智能体资料为演化器播种技能。

evidence.quote: build the framework knowledge and SOTA reference the Evolve Agent reads as skills.
evidence.support_explanation: 演化器读取的“SOTA 参考”技能来自外部检索的前沿编码智能体资料——引入了未对基线开放的外部先验。

evidence.quote: The frozen harness transfers without re-evolution: on SWE-bench-verified it achieves the highest aggregate success while using
evidence.support_explanation: 迁移主张：SWE-bench-verified 总成功率最高且更省 token。

evidence.quote: AHE and the two self-evolve baselines are evolved on Terminal-Bench 2 and evaluated without in-domain re-evolution.
evidence.support_explanation: SWE-bench 为真正的异基准留出评估。我们读 Table 2 单元格：AHE 75.6% vs 种子 75.2%（+0.4 点≈500 题中 2 题），token 461k vs 526k。

evidence.quote: AHE instead achieves the highest aggregate, with the seed-relative gain concentrating on django and sphinx-doc
evidence.support_explanation: 增益集中在 django 与 sphinx-doc。

evidence.quote: Marginal regressions appear only on the three smallest repositories, consistent with pass@1 variance on small repos exceeding the per-repo gain.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者承认小仓库回退并归因于方差。

evidence.quote: so cross-model transfer numbers conflate harness portability with operating-point coupling
evidence.support_explanation: 跨模型迁移数值混杂了可移植性与运行点耦合（步预算/超时调到 GPT-5.4 high）。

evidence.quote: Three of the four single-component variants outperform the seed; the system-prompt swap is the only regression.
evidence.support_explanation: 单组件换入：memory/tool/middleware 优于种子，system prompt 反而下降。

evidence.quote: Most single-component swaps already beat the seed, and the single-component gains overshoot
evidence.support_explanation: 单组件增益之和（+11.1）超过完整 AHE（+7.3），组件非可加。

evidence.quote: Memory adds 12 boundary-case lessons (performance margin, queued-over-limit cancellation, evaluator-style closure, source-packaging layout); on Hard the lessons lift it above full AHE, while on Easy they reduce to superfluous re-verification.
evidence.support_explanation: 长期记忆内容是 TB2 任务邻近的“边界情形教训”，Hard 上强于完整 AHE。

evidence.quote: Each evolution round, our evolve model produces a change manifest naming which Terminal-Bench 2 tasks it expects to fix in the next round and which it flags at risk of regression.
evidence.support_explanation: 演化器看到并按名字预测 TB2 任务——任务级身份进入编辑循环。

evidence.quote: sit roughly 5x above the random-prediction baselines of 6.5% and 10.6%, so each harness edit lands on a real, agent-anticipated target rather than on an arbitrary subset of the panel.
evidence.support_explanation: 修复预测约为随机基线的 5 倍（精度 33.7%、召回 51.4%）。

evidence.quote: The agent can justify why an edit should help, but it cannot reliably name the tasks the same edit is about to break, which is what produces the non-monotone steps in the evolution curve of §
evidence.support_explanation: 回归“盲视”：非单调演化曲线的来源。

evidence.quote: on most rounds: across the 9 rounds the agent issued 43 unique regression predictions and only 5 landed, giving cumulative
evidence.support_explanation: 43 条回归预测仅 5 条命中。

evidence.quote: This work studies a promising but high-variance setting, and the scope of our claims should be interpreted accordingly.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者承认高方差场景。

evidence.quote: AHE bounds edits to a workspace, attributes every change in a versioned manifest, and rolls back ineffective edits at file granularity, but it does not provide a complete guardrail stack.
evidence.support_explanation: 治理能力受限：有版本化清单与文件粒度回滚，无完整护栏。

evidence.quote: A seed already fitted to the target benchmark would contaminate every subsequent edit
evidence.support_explanation: 刻意使用最小 bash-only 种子，避免种子已适配基准。

evidence.quote: Infrastructure-aborted or timed-out trials count as failures under pass@1 (matching the official terminal-bench leaderboard) and are excluded from token means to avoid truncated figures.
evidence.support_explanation: 失败按官方口径计入分母；token 均值排除中断试验。

evidence.quote: rollouts per task so each task carries a pass-rate signal, which stabilizes pass@1 and lets partial-pass tasks anchor comparative diagnosis.
evidence.support_explanation: 每任务 k≥2 次 rollout（附录 Table 4 为 k=2）。

evidence.quote: By difficulty, the only exception is the Hard tier, where AHE marginally trails Codex.
evidence.support_explanation: Hard 档位 AHE 略低于 Codex。

evidence.quote: The headline finding is that all five gains land positive
evidence.support_explanation: 跨模型：五个基底均为正增益（+2.3~+10.1 点），但任务集与演化集相同。

evidence.quote: The gaps to ACE and TF-GRPO trace to a layer mismatch.
evidence.support_explanation: 与 ACE/TF-GRPO 的差距被解释为“层不匹配”；基线预算/先验是否对等未说明。

evidence.quote: Since the evolve agent optimises an aggregate dominated by 55 Medium tasks, it converges to a Medium-heavy trade-off that returns part of the Hard memory effect, and we leave interaction-aware evolution to future work.
evidence.support_explanation: 优化目标为总体 pass@1，导致对 Medium 偏向。

evidence.quote: Rather than roll either back, the iteration-7 round patched a loophole in the guard and a salience gap in the middleware
evidence.support_explanation: 迭代 7 分数回落（75.8→73.0）后演化器选择打补丁而非回滚：回滚是裁决后的酌情动作。

evidence.quote: AHE outperforms every baseline on our panel: three human-designed harnesses, OpenCode
evidence.support_explanation: 头条对比面板。

evidence.quote: against the seed: encoding behavior in tools, middleware, and memory avoids the per-call re-derivation cost prompt-only baselines incur.
evidence.support_explanation: token 节省的作者解释；Table 2 给出 461k vs 526k（种子）。

signatures.object: 编码智能体 harness 的七类文件级组件：系统提示、工具描述、工具实现、中间件、技能、子智能体配置、长期记忆（NexAU，git 工作区）
signatures.information: Agent Debugger 的分层证据（每任务分析报告+基准级概览+原始/清洗轨迹，含通过/失败）、上一轮清单裁决、完整演化历史；验证器/追踪器/LLM 配置只读。
signatures.operation: Evolve Agent 读取证据，选择组件层级，新增/修改/删除文件，每个逻辑编辑一次 git 提交。
signatures.output: 新的 harness H_t 与变更清单 C_t。
signatures.conditions: 种子=仅 bash 工具、无中间件/技能/子智能体/记忆；基底 GPT-5.4；k=2 rollout；十次迭代。

signatures.selection_rule_data: 每轮 pass@1>历史最佳则更新 H_best；报告所选最佳配置。数据=演化所用的同一 89 任务。
signatures.persistence: 工作区 git 历史与清单；长期记忆文件。
signatures.later_use: 下一轮 rollout 使用新 harness；冻结后迁移到 SWE-bench 与其他基底。
signatures.claimed_effect: TB2 69.7→77.0；SWE-bench-verified 最高总成功率且 token −12%；跨基底 +2.3~+10.1 点。
signatures.failure_boundary: 回归盲视；组件非可加；步预算/超时与运行点耦合；高方差。

signatures.object: 逐编辑的“可证伪契约”：变更清单（失败证据、根因、修复、预测修复集与风险回归集）及其下一轮裁决

signatures.operation: 第 t≥2 轮先做 Attribute：把预测集与观测到的任务翻转相交，得每编辑裁决，再 Rollback 被否决的编辑，之后才蒸馏与演化。
signatures.output: KEEP/IMPROVE/ROLLBACK 裁决与文件粒度回滚。
signatures.conditions: k=2 的单次评估；演化器可在裁决后选择回滚或补丁（E035）。
signatures.selection_rule_data: 不使用独立验证集；与演化同集。
signatures.later_use: 写入证据库供下一轮 Evolve Agent 读取。

gap.author_gap: harness 工程仍是手工活；自动化面临异质动作空间、淹没信号的长轨迹、以及难以归因的编辑；现有方法多只演化单一组件（提示、技能、playbook）。
gap.checked_gap: 三项具体障碍有来源且与编码智能体实践相符；最近邻（ACE、Training-Free GRPO）被实证比较，其它全 harness 演化工作在相关工作中仅作为类别提及。“可观测性是瓶颈而非智能体能力”是设计立场，论文并未单独检验。

claims.baseline_control: NexAU0 种子；三个人工 harness；同种子的 ACE 与 TF-GRPO
claims.selection_vs_test: 演化/晋升/报告同集；报告最佳迭代配置
claims.result_denominator: 89 题×2 rollout 的 pass@1；无方差；+7.3 点≈6–7 题
claims.counterevidence: 同集择优（胜者诅咒）、单次运行、Hard 略逊 Codex、基线预算/先验未说明。
claims.allowed_conclusion: 在被演化的 TB2 任务集上，所选 AHE 配置得分高于种子与所列基线；效应量的稳健性和对新任务的有效性未确认。

claims.text: 冻结后的 harness 无需再演化即可迁移：SWE-bench-verified 总成功率最高且 token 少 12%；跨三个基底族 +5.1~+10.1 点。
claims.setting: SWE-bench-verified 500 题；TB2 上五个替代基底（同 89 题）
claims.selection_vs_test: SWE-bench 为异基准留出；跨基底仍是演化所用任务
claims.counterevidence: 成功率仅 +0.4 点（约 2 题），三个小仓库回退；跨基底混杂运行点耦合且任务相同。
claims.allowed_conclusion: token 效率在 SWE-bench 上有改善；成功率提升与“编码通用工程经验”主张未获证实。

claims.text: 增益来自工具、中间件、长期记忆，而非系统提示；组件交互非可加。
claims.counterevidence: 单次运行、差值 2~3 题级；记忆含 TB2 邻近教训。
claims.allowed_conclusion: 方向性支持“事实性结构优于叙述性提示”，强度未量化。

claims.text: 可观测性（组件/经验/决策）使演化可靠；自归因对修复可靠、对回归近乎盲视。
claims.counterevidence: 未对三支柱做移除消融，无法判断可观测性是否是增益来源。
claims.allowed_conclusion: 关于自归因的描述性结论受支持；“可观测性是瓶颈”是设计论断，未被检验。

assessment.strongest_supported_claim: 在被演化的 Terminal-Bench 2 全部 89 题上，经十次迭代（取最佳迭代）得到的 harness 单次运行得分高于种子和所列基线；冻结后的 harness 在 SWE-bench-verified 上 token 用量下降约 12%，成功率与种子几乎持平（+0.4 点，弱 retained 证据）。作者的“编码通用工程经验”“可观测性是瓶颈”主张超出证据。
unresolved: 多次独立演化的方差与胜者诅咒幅度
基线是否拥有同等预算与外部先验
记忆中的 TB2 邻近教训对跨任务迁移的贡献

G.reason: 三个具体障碍（异质动作空间、轨迹淹没信号、编辑难归因）有明确来源，最近邻 ACE/TF-GRPO 被同种子实测，残余（只改提示层的方法在异基准上回退）有证据；扣分：其他全 harness 联合演化工作未被实证比较，“可观测性才是瓶颈”未被单独检验。

M.reason: 文件级组件、分层证据蒸馏、带预测的变更清单三者与三个障碍一一对应，并给出可区分预测（单组件分布、预测命中率）；扣分：支柱未被单独检验，三角色同模型，对朴素替代（直接读原始轨迹、不要清单）缺对照。

X.reason: 工作区布局、权限边界（只读验证器/LLM 配置）、清单字段、先归因后蒸馏的顺序、文件粒度回滚、git 版本、提示与超参均可重建；边界清楚：回归盲视、非可加、运行点耦合、治理不完整。

E.measurement.reason: TB2 官方验证器与 SWE-bench-verified 官方评测，基础设施中断按失败计入（更严）；扣分：验证器输出同时进入演化循环，演化器的“镜像评估器”规则与任务邻近记忆可能把评估者特征编码进 harness。

E.causality.reason: 有同种子的 ACE/TF-GRPO 对比和单组件换入消融，自归因有随机基线；但核心因果主张（可观测性三支柱）未被消融，基线的演化预算/外部先验不明（演化器额外读取联网 SOTA 技能），单次运行、差值只有几题。

E.holdout.reason: 头条在被演化与择优的同一 89 题上；真正异基准的 SWE-bench 成功率增量仅 +0.4 点；跨基底评估仍是演化所用任务，记忆含 TB2 邻近教训，演化器按任务名预测。优点：刻意使用最小种子、提供 SWE-bench 与 token 指标。

E.statistics.reason: 有样本规模、各档位/仓库明细和负向结果（Hard 略逊、小仓库回退、回归盲视），自归因附随机基线；但主结果为单次演化运行与 k=2，无区间/重复，作者自承高方差。

E.cost.reason: 报告推理 token 与 Succ/Mtok、32 小时墙钟及超时按失败；缺演化与调试器的 token/费用，无与基线的预算对等说明。

rationale: 机制与附录可重建、官方验证器、对ACE/TF-GRPO同种子比较，诚实披露回归盲视；但演化/择优/报告同集、单次演化运行，SWE-bench成功率仅+0.4点，支柱未消融。
